description: Trace a delegation from the root to the authority, like dig +trace: each referral and its glue, lame or unreachable servers, the final answer and its TTLs. Use it when a name fails at a zone cut or after a nameserver change, not for one record (dig) or whether the zone's servers agree (sweep_domain). Each hop is asked with RD=0 over TCP from the isitdns edge, or from a probe where the edge cannot dial, with no key and a limit of 100 calls a minute per address. Give the full host name: the walk ends at the zone that answers for it, and type (default A) is what it asks there.

name.description: The name to walk. Also as "domain"; a URL is read as its host.

type.description: Record type for the final question

name: trace

api.description: The /api GET that asks it again, as a new reading

askAgain.description: The isitdns.net page that asks it again, when one does

receipts.description: One per DNS read: what, of whom, from where, when, rcode, flags, EDE, ms, answer

report.description: verdict, headline, steps, the TTL facts, meaning

trace.description: query, readAt, hops, failed dials, finalAnswer, warnings

title: Trace a delegation
